note: Machine-readable wiring entry points for the case line. This unit does not modify src; these entries name the existing consumer seams and the data each standard piece expects.
quantization: All four GLBs declare KHR_mesh_quantization in extensionsUsed and extensionsRequired for int8 normals; three 0.186.1 GLTFLoader supports that extension natively and needs no extra decoder. NORMAL and COLOR_0 elements use a 4-byte stride.

pieces.loader: GLTFLoader; MeshoptDecoder/KTX2Loader are not required (no compressed buffers or textures)
pieces.restMountSource: GLB scene extras (gltf.scene.userData.restMount); this entry mirrors restMount.translation and verticalFovDeg; the rx24-root node itself has no extras

nodeContract.rifle-static: receiver remains fixed in the group
nodeContract.rifle-magazine: translate by source reload phase withdraw 0.22-0.55 and insert 0.55-0.77
nodeContract.support-hand: runtime gripOffset drives the support palm; sleeve remains procedural until a hand rig exists

pieces.preserves: Simulation damage, cadence, spread, recoil input and reload timing are unchanged; the GLB is presentation only.

nodeContract.enemy-root: fall pivot; death rotates around X
nodeContract.spine: idle, walk bob, fire and hit flinch
nodeContract.head: idle and hit flinch
nodeContract.weapon: fire kick; no magazine node yet

pieces.preserves: src/sim hit volumes, damage and AI remain authoritative; animation is presentation only.

nodeContract.collision: 13 boxes in the GLB scene extras (three.js gltf.scene.userData), the same data as contracts/passage-cover.actions.json; convert to map Box records without changing the simulation
nodeContract.dimensions: corridor/doorway dimensions in the same scene extras; the root node passage-cover-root and mesh node passage-cover carry no duplicate copies
nodeContract.modules: module instances in the same scene extras
nodeContract.materialBinding: object-space UV metres / 2 bound to the existing courtyard concrete colour chain

pieces.preserves: Collision and navigation must be authored from the boxes and re-baked offline; never generate navigation from render geometry at runtime.

nodeContract.hit-marker: camera-space billboard at 0.5 m; select hit-body/head/kill clip
nodeContract.impact-burst: world-space burst at the ray endpoint, radius 0.035 m

pieces.preserves: A miss must not show a marker or play a hit cue; friendly fire uses faction-cool and no kill accent.
